post.summary: Get relations to IPv4 address entities

post.description: To create an IPv4 network a domain, a net mandator and a netrange name is required. There are three creation modes: CIDR, prefix and subnet mask. In the "CIDR" mode the attribute "ID" (e.g.  192.168.178.1/24) has to be specified in "CIDR-notation". In the "prefix" mode the "attribute-ID" which is the "net-ID" must be specified by an "IP address" and for the attribute "PREFIX_LENGTH" the "prefix length" must be specified. In the "subnet mask" mode the attribute "ID" which is the "net-ID" must be specified by an "IP address" and the attribute "SUBNETMASK" which declares the "subnet mask" must be specified.
